payload.summary: Merged via PR #23 (merge commit): git-style store-root walk-up from canonicalized cwd, bounded by the nearest .git entry (worktrees isolated), no walk outside git repos; init stays cwd-strict; validate/skills tolerant open. Review rounds hardened every downstream consumer to follow the resolved root: doctor healthcheck child, dispatch worker spawn, skills CLI (resolve-once absolute path — probe and spawn resolve relative PATH entries against different dirs, so one resolution must feed both), clone fallback relative specs, import default source. Codex: 5 rounds, APPROVE r5 no findings. Committee merge per standing small-PR rule. Sanity check after merge: bun test on main.
